notes: The native Go build for Windows 7/8/32-bit machines now opens the same opencode-style full-screen app as the main CLI: header bar, boxed editor with a real cursor, transcript scrollback, ctrl+x menu, slash palette, colors via the Windows Console API (no ANSI needed — genuine conhost-safe), esc-to-interrupt and multi-turn conversations with token counting. The main CLI is unchanged underneath this release.
